scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w gallery-app
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w indexer && npm run build -w streamer && npm run build -w downloader
scripts.start:all: npm run build && systemctl --user start gallery-indexer.service gallery-streamer.service gallery-downloader.service gallery-ocr.service
scripts.start:indexer: npm run build:backend && systemctl --user start gallery-indexer.service
scripts.start:streamer: npm run build:backend && systemctl --user start gallery-streamer.service
scripts.start:downloader: npm run build:backend && systemctl --user start gallery-downloader.service
scripts.start:ocr: npm run build:backend && systemctl --user start gallery-ocr.service
scripts.restart:all: npm run build && systemctl --user restart gallery-indexer.service gallery-streamer.service gallery-downloader.service gallery-ocr.service
scripts.restart:indexer: npm run build:backend && systemctl --user restart gallery-indexer.service
scripts.restart:streamer: npm run build:backend && systemctl --user restart gallery-streamer.service
scripts.restart:downloader: npm run build:backend && systemctl --user restart gallery-downloader.service
scripts.restart:ocr: npm run build:backend && systemctl --user restart gallery-ocr.service
scripts.stop:all: systemctl --user stop gallery-indexer.service gallery-streamer.service gallery-downloader.service gallery-ocr.service
scripts.status:all: systemctl --user status gallery-indexer.service gallery-streamer.service gallery-downloader.service gallery-ocr.service --no-pager
